sections.title: Scene 1: Aerial View with Drone
sections.summary: The scene shows an aerial view of a landscape with clouds and hills. A drone is flying over the landscape, leaving a trail of smoke behind it.

sections.title: Scene 2: Panoramic View of Mountains
sections.summary: The scene shows a panoramic view of mountains from an aerial perspective. The sky above is clear blue with fluffy white clouds, and the mountains are covered in vegetation.

sections.title: Scene 3: Video Call with Painless 360
sections.summary: The scene shows a video call with a person holding a smartphone displaying the video call interface. The background of the video call is an outdoor setting with rolling hills and a body of water.

sections.title: Scene 4: Grey Gradient Background
sections.summary: The scene shows a grey gradient background with a darker grey strip that appears to be a button. There is no visible content on this strip, and the overall style of the image is minimalistic.

sections.title: Scene 5: Panoramic View of Mountainous Landscape
sections.summary: The scene shows a panoramic view of a mountainous landscape from an aerial perspective. The sky above is clear blue, and the mountains are covered in vegetation.
